decision: Replace the ten-person spatial-scene rule with a capacity-qualified long-carousel After Effects rule.
source: User correction: don't use spatial; use a long carousel; spatial and infographics are not AE templates.
scope: Matching-layer routing and contrasting accuracy case for VisualTasks requiring visuals of ten or more people.
reason: The earlier rule mixed separate visual systems into an After Effects template requirement. The corrected rule accepts only an AE media carousel whose measured sequential capacity holds the complete roster.

decision: Exclude text-only carousels, spatial scenes and infographic-system scenes from satisfying the long-carousel AE rule while leaving them classified in their own visual systems.
source: User correction and existing measured template capability records.
scope: Eligibility for the 10+ people AE-template route only.
reason: A carousel name alone does not prove media capacity. Requiring AE type, identity-carrying media, sequential reveal and sufficient measured media slots makes the route technically grounded without deleting other visual systems from the broader library.
